assets.name: 01 / ТОЧНЫЙ РЕЕСТР
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE premium iOS UI concept board for the physical-book library app with the working brand exactly "BOOK ORDER". Landscape canvas around 3:2, TWO straight-on full iPhone screens side by side, equal scale, large readable UI, minimal dark device outlines with realistic safe areas. Both screens must be fully visible. No real desk, no perspective, no web dashboard. This is a visual concept, not a shipped screenshot. The app scans ISBN, confirms a book, records its home or loan location, offers cover grid/list, searches and filters authors/genres. Maintain uncompromising organization and clarity.

Use the SAME meaningful sample data on both design-comparison screens. LEFT: main library view; total "128 книг", "7 выдано"; search "Название, автор, ISBN"; filters "Все", "Дом", "Дача", "Выдано"; visible compact grid/list toggle; three books, with ORIGINAL geometric typographic cover designs (do not copy publisher cover artwork): "Місто" / "Валер’ян Підмогильний" / "Дом · Полка 02"; "Лісова пісня" / "Леся Українка" / "Дача"; "The Little Prince" / "Antoine de Saint-Exupéry" / "Выдано · Олена". Keep main title large but author text comfortably readable. Bottom primary action "Сканировать ISBN" with barcode symbol, separated from a native three-item bottom tab bar "Книги", "Места", "Темы". Clear selected tab; no fourth tab. RIGHT: confirmation after scanning, standard back control "Назад", heading "Книга найдена"; large original typographic ivory book cover reading "Fantastic Mr. Fox" and "Roald Dahl" with one small angular fox emblem; below title and author; field "ISBN 978-014-0328-72-1"; selector "Дом / Полка 02"; secondary action "Изменить обложку"; primary action "Подтвердить"; unobtrusive action "Исправить данные". No bottom tabs on the confirmation modal. Good touch targets, legible labels, short status text, exact baselines. Do not add invented analytics, score gauges, notifications or unsupported features. The two screens illustrate the same design system and same theme. Keep Cyrillic correct; do not crop controls. Design direction: crisp modern Swiss administrative precision, notably lighter and quieter than a propaganda poster. Clean near-white #F5F6F7 canvas, deep ink navy #172B46 headings and buttons, one cobalt #2454AD active accent, neutral gray fine rules. Functional regular sans serif for body, firm medium-bold sans for headings, compact tabular numerals. No condensed shouting headlines. Main heading "Библиотека" in title case. Left screen uses tightly aligned spacious LIST rows, tiny book thumbnails, clear status lines and fine horizontal separators, no pill-shaped cards, almost-square 6pt radius controls. Counters integrated into one restrained line. Right screen uses white background and outlined metadata rows, a solid navy primary button. Small book-monolith emblem by the brand. On the board outside phones put exact top label "01 / ТОЧНЫЙ РЕЕСТР" and caption "Ясность. Структура. Порядок." Overall feeling professional, confident, systematic, exceptionally usable.
